title: Filesystem & Navigation
task: Start in the workspace root and navigate into services/api. Save the contents of env.txt as api-env.txt in the workspace root. Find the worker's owner.txt by moving through the sibling directory and save its contents as worker-owner.txt in the workspace root.
hints: From services/api the worker directory is ../worker.
Use ../../ to place both reports at the workspace root.

checks.label: The root report contains the API environment
checks.feedback: Read services/api/env.txt and write api-env.txt at the lab root.

checks.label: The root report contains the worker owner
checks.feedback: Read ../worker/owner.txt from services/api, then check the destination path.

demo.explanation: The relative path starts where this Bash session was before cd.
One .. finds the sibling directory. Two reach the root of this example project.
